record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.original_question: If x in X is a singular point of dimension n, is its normalized volume bounded above by 2(n - 1)^n, with equality only for the A_1 singularity?

evidence.quote:
Problem 27. If x ∈ X is singular, then vol( c x, X) ≤ 2(n − 1)n and the equality holds only for
A1-singularity.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X, x)$ be an $n$-dimensional klt (Kawamata log terminal) singularity over $\mathbb{C}$, where $x \in X$ is a closed point. Recall that the normalized volume of $(X, x)$, introduced by C. Li, is defined as
$$ \widehat{\mathrm{vol}}(x, X) \;=\; \inf_{v} \; A_X(v)^n \cdot \mathrm{vol}(v), $$
where the infimum runs over all real valuations $v$ of the function field of $X$ centered at $x$, $A_X(v)$ denotes the log discrepancy of $v$ with respect to $X$, and $\mathrm{vol}(v)$ denotes the volume of $v$. The $A_1$ singularity in dimension $n$ is the hypersurface singularity defined by $x_0^2 + x_1^2 + \cdots + x_n^2 = 0$ at the origin in $\mathbb{A}^{n+1}$; its normalized volume equals $2(n-1)^n$.

Prove or disprove: for every $n$-dimensional klt singularity $(X, x)$ with $x$ a singular point,
$$ \widehat{\mathrm{vol}}(x, X) \;\leq\; 2(n-1)^n, $$
and equality holds if and only if $(X, x)$ is the $n$-dimensional $A_1$ singularity.
artifact.category_tag: K-stability and normalized volumes of klt singularities
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that the normalized volume of an n-dimensional klt singularity is at most 2(n-1)^n, with equality only for the A_1 singularity (often attributed to Spotti–Sun and Li–Liu–Xu), remains open in general. Recent work (e.g., Moraga 2024 on toric singularities, and Liu 2025 on optimal bounds for threefold singularities) establishes the bound in special cases, but the full conjecture in arbitrary dimension is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Bounding toric singularities with normalized volume (Moraga, 2024)
status_evidence.snippet: The normalized volume of every toric singularity is bounded from above by that of the rational double point of the same dimension.
status_evidence.claim: The conjectured upper bound is established in the toric case, but not in general.

status_evidence.title: Optimal bounds for local volumes of threefold singularities (Liu)
status_evidence.snippet: Optimal upper bound for local volumes of klt threefold singularities, with classification of those of large volume.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is studied in dimension three; the general n-dimensional statement remains open.
